encounter.off_app.title: A passenger leans in: 'Bro, want to do this trip outside the app? I will give you full cash.'
encounter.off_app.choice.accept: Accept off-app trip (No commission, full cash)
encounter.off_app.choice.stay_app: Politely decline and stay on Uthao app
encounter.off_app.choice.negotiate: Negotiate a higher private cash fare
encounter.sudden_rain.title: Sky turns dark and torrential Dhaka rain pours down! Roads are slick and hazardous.
encounter.sudden_rain.choice.cautious: Drive cautiously at lower speed (Safe & steady)
encounter.sudden_rain.choice.shelter: Take shelter under a tea stall canopy until it lightens
encounter.sudden_rain.choice.push_fast: Push through at full speed for a rush tip (High slip risk)
encounter.extra_stop.title: Passenger asks: 'Bhai, could you stop at that shop for 2 minutes on the way?'
encounter.extra_stop.choice.agree: Agree cheerfully without asking for extra money
encounter.extra_stop.choice.refuse: Politely decline due to tight schedule
encounter.parent_child.title: Mrs. Ferdousi holds her child's hand: 'Please ride very gently, I have my child with me.'
encounter.parent_child.choice.smooth: Reassure her and ride smoothly on calm roads
encounter.parent_child.choice.helmet: Help secure helmet and adjust footpegs
encounter.urgent_exam.title: Student panics: 'Bhai! Exam starts in 10 minutes! Please get me there fast!'
encounter.urgent_exam.choice.speed: Weave through traffic smoothly to arrive in time
encounter.urgent_exam.choice.steady: Maintain safe steady pace and calm the student
encounter.wrong_pickup_pin.title: Passenger calls: 'Sorry bhai, the pin went to the alley, I am waiting by the main junction!'
encounter.wrong_pickup_pin.choice.drive: Drive around to pick them up at the junction
encounter.wrong_pickup_pin.choice.walk: Ask them to walk over to the pinned location
encounter.wrong_pickup_pin.choice.cancel: Cancel the ride due to misplaced pin
encounter.vendor_discount.title: Bablu the street vendor smiles: 'Sales were dry today bhai, could you take ৳20 less?'
encounter.vendor_discount.choice.grant: Give ৳20 discount to support a fellow worker
encounter.vendor_discount.choice.standar: Politely explain you need to cover fuel costs
encounter.vendor_discount.choice.tea_fav: Trade discount for a tea stall token
encounter.phone_left.title: You notice an expensive smartphone left behind on the pillion seat!
encounter.phone_left.choice.return: Rush back immediately to return the phone
encounter.phone_left.choice.police: Hand over to SI Morshed at traffic police booth
encounter.phone_left.choice.keep: Keep the phone (High risk, morally questionable)
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.title: Police checkpoint ahead! SI Morshed is waving bikes over for inspection.
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.choice.coop: Stop politely and present valid license and registration
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.choice.expl: Explain you have a passenger in a hurry
encounter.traffic_checkpoint.choice.fine: Accept citation and pay accumulated infraction fine
encounter.bus_block.title: A reckless local bus is stranded sideways, completely blocking the carriageway!
encounter.bus_block.choice.sidewalk: Squeeze along the curb / narrow sidewalk alley
encounter.bus_block.choice.wait: Wait patiently for the gridlock to unravel
encounter.bus_block.choice.honk: Honk and guide the bus helper to clear space
encounter.regular_direct_call.title: Your phone rings — a regular passenger is calling for a direct booking!
encounter.regular_direct_call.choice.acc: Accept direct booking (0% commission, full earnings)
encounter.regular_direct_call.choice.dec: Decline politely as you are occupied
encounter.friend_package.title: Mintu calls from his tea stall: 'Dosto, can you rush this spare parts package to Farmgate?'
encounter.wait_errand.title: Passenger asks: 'Wait here 5 minutes while I buy medicine, okay?'
encounter.wait_errand.choice.end: End the trip here so they can book another later
